purpose: Decide from projectability and the fixed ADM variable map whether the exact spatial q=0 scalar-shift channel is the same dynamical object as the punctured finite-q limit. This gate does not compute the final homogeneous exchange amplitude; it determines the correct channel architecture before any s6fF ZERO/NONZERO rerun.
required_checks: at exact q=0 the scalar gradient shift N_i vanishes identically for regular beta_0
K_beta(0)=0 and all local gradient-shift sources vanish at exact q=0
the finite-q beta solution has no regular q->0 coordinate limit for generic nonzero dot(zeta)
therefore beta_0 is not a local constraint variable continuously inherited from finite q
a spatially homogeneous zeta_0 rescales the FLRW scale factor and belongs to the homogeneous/background sector
projectable Hamiltonian information at q=0 is global rather than the finite-q local elliptic constraint
because s6fI is direction dependent, no unique punctured prescription can be promoted to the exact homogeneous channel
outcome_policy: PASS if the exact homogeneous channel is rigorously separated from the punctured finite-q channel. If they are proven identical despite s6fI, PASS with that explicit proof. Do not choose a direction-averaged or special-mu punctured limit post hoc.
forbidden: identifying exact q=0 with mu=0, mu=1, or an angular average of the punctured limit
inventing a local projectable lapse Fourier mode
fitting any coefficient to restore continuity
